structural_change: HBMb/IDXSU-PS15 10-21 r6a: pgcol_l r5 (CLOSED 0fb4501e8, RTL / outline 345.6 x 453.6 / SRAM placement / route recipe unchanged) RE-PINNED so EVERY port sits on the S (clk / command) face.  Why (parent pslice_c5 lp13a/lp14a/b, ep9/pve1 4_1_cts + offline TT STA on the lp13a db): r5 split its interface across opposite faces of a 453.6-um macro (clk + command S, cfg / start / length / rst_n N), so every parent had to cross the macro once more in ONE cycle: either the cfg data (lp13a: 312 u_c1-3/cfg_data endpoints TT -168..-216 ps, the only failing group; every S leaf / output / landing group MET +85..+260) or the clock (lp14a MX flip: L soft insertion 774-990 ps, pair 167-224 TT).  No buffer site exists over the macro.  r6 puts the parent read halves 10-50 um from the cfg pins in the same strip box as the clock entry (no crossing, no added cycle).  MAIN: command left of the clk pin as r5, cfg / start / length / rst_n group right of edge_index (x 186-341.6, beside the R0 SRAM column).  Prior: SUCCESSOR of the flat per-quarter SU programme tile (hbm_su_pslice_r3_1017 gate FAIL 8058137fc: TT clock insertion 851..1280 ps, spread 429, GRT 4 h timeout; hbm_su_pslice_r4_1017 294f94bbd: TT 830..1148 ps, spread 318, GRT > 3.5 h with clock NDRs dropped, killed): one root over 98 SRAMs + 14k flops on 940 x 760 um. r5 = cluster ot_hbm_su_programme_pslice_c5: one leaf per command column (own packed 16-edge/row index, own dictionary, own 256 command flops, controller replica) + a head leaf (cfg stage + column decode + fault OR). Lockstep bench vs r4 on all 4 quarters PASS, mutants cfg/phase/cfg
